description: On the tabletop in front of you are a pair of eyeglasses and an open, beige glasses case, with a dark pillow in the background. The left hand reaches forward toward the glasses while the right hand also moves in, and the glasses become a two-hand object as they’re lifted and rotated so the temples fold; then the right hand guides the folded glasses into the open case while the left hand steadies the case, and both hands close and secure the case, releasing it back onto the table.
